alignments.note: Substantival article takes the pronoun the ASV supplies to make the participle a clause subject, under rule 41.
Participle rendered as a finite English verb.
The ASV promotes this bare nominal to the English object of *maketh*.

The other bare nominal of the double accusative, which the ASV construes as a locative: the supplied *in* states what it contributes and joins its unit under rule 33, discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25. The margin's literal gloss (*thy border peace*) corroborates the recasting and decides nothing, by rule 38.
Pronominal suffix as possessive under rule 18.

Finite verb with its subject pronoun under rule 17; the *with* is the preposition the English verb's valency needs to reach the bare second accusative, and joins the verb's unit under rule 44, discontinuous around the object pronoun under rule 25.
Construct noun with a supplied *the* under rule 29, headed on the word carrying the lexeme. The margin's literal gloss (*fat of wheat*) was read and set aside, by rule 38.
Nomen rectum takes the chain's *of* under rule 19; the ASV renders it arthrously with a *the* of its own, no article morpheme standing in the phrase, so that determiner is the noun's under rule 15.
